content.thinking: Scrolling the guide now: I've reached the savings-product list, where checking accounts, deposits and savings plans are the items I recognize. The term קרן כספית is unfamiliar to me, so I'll look it up once I've finished reading this section.

The screen jumped and I missed the deposit and savings boxes, so I'm going by the money-market fund and the other items I did read: short-term state loans and bank deposits, which sound low-risk but don't say what they pay. I'll skip the pension and the children's savings, since those aren't my money.
הבנתי שאני לא מתאים לחשבון ניירות ערך או למסלול מניות, ואני מתעניין באיגרות חוב ממשלתיות — שאני מכיר כבטוחות — אבל עדיין לא בטוח אם הן מתעדכנות עם המדד.

I've read through the page's explanations of the bond and money-market products, and I skipped the pension, index and broker sections. I'm not sure what the page's source is or what it earns from, so I'd suggest checking with your bank before deciding anything.

input.answer: I haven't decided anything. I'll ask you, and maybe the bank, about government bonds, the "צמודה" kind that follows the price index, and about מק"מ. This page only explains what things are: it has no numbers comparing them to my deposits and nothing about what the bank charges me.
